voice: Correct Heinrich Daniel Ruhmkorff's name while preserving the lantern and induction-coil descriptions.

entries.text: A Ruhmkorff coil lantern with a hand crank on the base.

Ruhmkorff's coil consists of copper wire insulated by a silk covering, surrounded by another coil of fine insulated wire in which a momentary current is induced when current passes through the inner coil from a voltaic battery charged by a hand crank.
Heinrich Daniel Ruhmkorff, an able instrument maker, greatly improved the induction coil. In 1864, he received France's Volta Prize for his work with electricity.
